name: inbox-assistant
description: Query inbox-assistant state, content, and preferences.

actions.name: prefs show
actions.description: Show preferences.json.

actions.name: prefs set
actions.description: Set a top-level preference key.

actions.name: prefs keys
actions.description: List valid top-level preference keys.

actions.name: prefs unset
actions.description: Remove a preference key.

actions.name: categories show
actions.description: Show configured categories or defaults.

actions.name: categories init-defaults
actions.description: Initialize default categories if none are configured.

actions.name: categories add
actions.description: Add a category to the category configuration.

parameters.name: description
parameters.description: Description for when to use this category

actions.name: categories remove
actions.description: Remove a configured category.

actions.name: categories update
actions.description: Update an existing category.

actions.name: categories reset
actions.description: Reset categories to the default set.

actions.name: categories colors
actions.description: List valid Outlook category colors.

actions.name: email list
actions.description: List ingested emails.

actions.name: email changes
actions.description: List emails changed since a checkpoint.

parameters.name: since
parameters.description: Only emails updated after this ISO timestamp

actions.name: email get
actions.description: Get a single email plus attachment manifests.

actions.name: email thread
actions.description: Get all emails in a thread plus attachment manifests.

actions.name: email project-batch
actions.description: Return message bundles for manager-side inbox projection.

parameters.name: since
parameters.description: Only emails updated after this ISO timestamp

parameters.name: received_after
parameters.description: Only emails received at or after this ISO timestamp

parameters.name: received_before
parameters.description: Only emails received before this ISO timestamp

actions.name: attachment list
actions.description: List attachment manifests.

actions.name: attachment meta
actions.description: Get attachment manifest metadata.

actions.name: attachment text
actions.description: Get extracted text for an attachment.

actions.name: attachment fetch
actions.description: Resolve or copy a stored attachment blob.

parameters.name: output
parameters.description: Optional output path to copy the attachment to

actions.name: draft create
actions.description: Create a new draft message in the delegated mailbox.

parameters.name: to_recipients
parameters.description: To recipient email. Repeat or use comma-separated values.

parameters.name: cc_recipients
parameters.description: CC recipient email. Repeat or use comma-separated values.

parameters.name: bcc_recipients
parameters.description: BCC recipient email. Repeat or use comma-separated values.

parameters.name: body_file
parameters.description: Read draft body from a UTF-8 text file

parameters.name: attachments
parameters.description: Attach a local file. Repeat to add multiple attachments.

parameters.name: timeout_seconds
parameters.description: Maximum time to wait for the inbox runtime to create the draft.

actions.name: draft reply
actions.description: Create a reply or reply-all draft for an existing message.

parameters.name: subject
parameters.description: Optional subject override for the reply draft

parameters.name: body
parameters.description: Reply text to place above the quoted thread

parameters.name: body_file
parameters.description: Read reply text from a UTF-8 text file

parameters.name: attachments
parameters.description: Attach a local file. Repeat to add multiple attachments.

parameters.name: reply_all
parameters.description: Create a reply-all draft instead of reply

parameters.name: timeout_seconds
parameters.description: Maximum time to wait for the inbox runtime to create the draft.

actions.name: search
actions.description: Search emails, attachments, and facts using unified search.

parameters.name: mode
parameters.description: Search mode: hybrid, fts, or vector

actions.name: ask
actions.description: Ask inbox-assistant in natural language with grounded retrieval.

actions.name: context
actions.description: Show resolved inbox binding and mailbox context.

actions.name: dbpath
actions.description: Get the absolute path to the inbox database.

actions.name: sync-status
actions.description: Show per-folder sync checkpoints.

actions.name: stats
actions.description: Show mailbox corpus statistics.

examples: aech-cli-inbox-assistant ask 'remember that email about budget?'
